boundedClaim: Native receipt semantics plus bounded authenticated HTTP representation. Field rules/outcomes unchanged; the API-only 1MiB overflow maps to SOURCE_REFUSED/SCOPE_INCOMPLETE under the accepted API contract. Runtime acceptance requires real native and HTTP consumers, full mutation/parity tests and frozen fixture receipts. No operational coverage, PostgreSQL API run, durable action, production or AI governance claim. TypeScript HTTP consumer adds flat family/UTF8 digest and actor/window checks with full84 mutation evidence, then a safe transient UI projection; it does not validate deep native lineage or add operational coverage. Isolated development composition admits only the exact frozen synthetic dataset/metadata authority and two fixed contexts; normal coverage None remains. Stage A in-process HTTP evidence is nonphysical; persistent PostgreSQL and OS resource effects require separate Stage B admission.
